name: Wisconsin School of Business

gmat_classic.stat: average GMAT score, 80% score distribution 630-700; page states scores are based on a previous version of the exam (classic edition confirmed)

work_exp_years.stat: average years of professional work experience

women_pct.stat: page publishes counts, not percent: 39 female students of 79 enrolled; percent computed

intl_pct.stat: page publishes counts, not percent: 13 international students of 79 enrolled; percent computed

tuition_usd.stat: 2026-27 rate, nonresident tuition only (51,413.28); segregated fees 1,699.48 and first-year program fee 400 itemized separately; Wisconsin resident tuition 27,764.80

salary_median_usd.stat: average starting salary, Classes of 2023-2025 aggregate; median not published

employment_rate_pct.stat: received offers within three months of graduation, Classes of 2023-2025 aggregate

notes: Class profile publishes women and international as raw counts; percentages above are computed from the page's own counts (39/79 and 13/79). GRE averages and acceptance rate are not published on the official pages. Salary is an average, not a median; school does not publish a median. Employment and salary figures are a three-class aggregate labeled Classes of 2023-2025 on the page.
